thread:
jamal: Planning note  scheduling a staging pen-test dry run next Tue 09:00 PT. Focus: RBAC gating, KMS grant behavior, sanitized audit slices. Need ops lead and uploader.
emily: SGTM. Do we have an evidence manifest schema yet?
jamal: Not formalized. Proposal: per-bundle manifest with fields: object, sha256, kms_key_arn, presign_ttl, uploader, grant_arn. Keep it small so assessor can verify integrity.
tanya: Ill take ops lead for the dry run. Ops preference: provide a 1h rolling window sample for most services and a targeted 24h slice for any endpoints flagged high-risk. No DB exports.
mike: For KMS we should issue a time-bound Grant scoped to Decrypt with EncryptionContext constraint (purpose=pt-evidence). That way we avoid giving kms:Decrypt on the key itself to a role. I can script it.
jamal: Good. Two items to confirm: 1) how we prove the assessor can only decrypt specific ciphertext, 2) who performs the upload + signs manifest.
kms-bot: KMS hint: create-grant allows constraints. Example (edited for thread):
```
aws kms create-grant \
  --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01 \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pen-test-auditor \
  --operations Decrypt \
  --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"purpose":"pt-evidence"}
```
Grant can be revoked programmatically after window.
emily: Manifest example: {object: "svc-auth-logs-2026-03-19.tar.gz", sha256: "<hash>", kms: "arn:aws:kms:...", ttl: "3600", uploader: "mike"}. Also we should include a signature field (GPG or KMS-signed) and a short README with sanitization notes.
mike: I'll run the upload workflow tonight to staging and return the presign + grant info. Draft script:
```
ART=svc-auth-logs-2026-03-19.tar.gz
aws s3 cp $ART s3://redwood-pt-staging/$ART
GRANT=$(aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/staging-logs --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pen-test-auditor --operations Decrypt --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"purpose":"pt-evidence"})
PRESIGN=$(aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-staging/$ART --expires-in 3600)
```
Note: script will output grant ARN and presign URL to a short-lived manifest file.
jamal: Perfect. Ops: please ensure host-level audit logs (syscalls/kube-audit) for the 1h window are captured and sanitized. Tanya, can you add a sanitization checklist item?
tanya: Yes. Checklist: 1) remove user PII, 2) obfuscate IPs to /24, 3) confirm no secrets in logs, 4) security team sign-off before handoff. I'll run the check at 08:30 PT on test day.
emily: Add to evidence checklist: sha256, manifest signed, grant ARN, presign TTL, assessor contact, and a short allowed-operations note.
jamal: Retest plan: prefer a 2-week retest window after remediation. If fixes alter privileges or introduce new risk, freeze deploys for affected service and escalate in #incidents.
mike: Upload complete. Manifest (presigned): https://staging.s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-pt-staging/svc-auth-logs-2026-03-19-manifest.json
Grant ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:grant/1a2b3c4d5e6f
Presign TTL: 3600s
(Will monitor access logs and post a short access snapshot post-run.)
jamal: Thanks. Action items recap:
- tanya: ops lead + sanitization check
- mike: uploader + grant creation (done)
- emily: manifest schema + sign requirement
- jamal: assessor coordination + retest cadence
Please react with :thumbsup: if you ack.
emily: :thumbsup:
tanya: :thumbsup: I'll run the sanitization script at 08:30 PT.
mike: :thumbsup: monitoring access.

jamal: We'll hold a 30min post-mortem in #eng-security the day after the dry run to capture gaps and adjust the retest schedule. Thanks everyone."
